method: Read680 additional lines: paint finalization, homepage, highlighting and filter/sort logic. Compiled unchanged highlight helper with3 synthetic assertions.
findings: Confirmed unchanged highlighted_text_ranges returns empty for identical text/query İ because lowercased query has2scalars but original text has1; window-size check skips. ASCII Alpha/alpha and Cyrillic identical controls pass. This is false-negative highlighting, not search-engine mismatch or panic.
Homepage creates exactly6 items unconditionally despite function name for_settings; previously read paint label fixed8 sources. Count label mismatch now source-resolved, no visual fixture.

UI best-match sort recomputes title/path/source relevance and clamps engine base score0..500. Engine order/Hit@3 metrics alone do not prove final visible ranking. Alphabetic sort recalculates lowercase names inside comparator; no benchmark.

Files filter accepts only FILE/RECENT, excluding FILE_CONTENT/PDF/DOCX; Images accepts IMAGE/copy_image or FILE/RECENT image extensions, excluding OCR source itself. Thus content matches can appear in All yet vanish under nominal file/image filters. Some engine OCR paths emit FILE, so not all OCR is lost.
Image filter includes ico/tiff/svg while thumbnail image_path_for_result supports png/jpg/jpeg/bmp/gif/webp. Being image-filter-visible is not a guarantee of thumbnail support.

has_prefix earlier omits some prefixes handled here such as image/screenshots and ql/snip/notes elsewhere; inconsistent UI layout/fast-worker routing needs exact query fixtures rather than general scope-correctness claim.
Guidance footer Index ready is gated by shows_guidance_footer returning false, so it is dead display code; do not cite string as observed false-ready status.
Filter categories overlap intentionally: an image FILE can count in Files and Images. Sum of category counts need not equal All; this alone is not duplicate-result proof.
limits: No local production changes or Windows integration.

executed_controls.output: ASCII/Cyrillic controls passed; identical capital dotted-I has no highlight
